# Alex Morgan

> Portfolio of Alex Morgan, full stack developer: projects, case studies and writing.

Full Stack Developer, based in Anywhere, Earth. Contact: hello@example.com. GitHub: https://github.com/octocat.

## Case studies
- [Northwind Dashboard](https://salahu01.github.io/quietfolio-template/work/northwind-dashboard): Northwind Dashboard is a sample analytics app used to show how a case study page looks: a cover image, a short intro, headings, lists, code and a table, all…
- [Pocket Budget](https://salahu01.github.io/quietfolio-template/work/pocket-budget): Pocket Budget is a sample mobile app. The goal: log an expense in under five seconds, even with no signal.
- [Plainfile CLI](https://salahu01.github.io/quietfolio-template/work/plainfile-cli): Plainfile is a sample command-line tool that keeps folders of plain text files in sync, with a --dry-run mode so you can see changes before they happen.

## Blog
- [Getting started with quietfolio](https://salahu01.github.io/quietfolio-template/blog/getting-started-with-quietfolio): quietfolio is a minimal developer portfolio template. It is a static Next.js site with a home page, case studies and a blog. This post is sample content that…
- [How the SEO and AEO setup works](https://salahu01.github.io/quietfolio-template/blog/how-the-seo-setup-works): Search engines and AI answer engines both read the same signals: clean HTML, accurate metadata and structured data. quietfolio ships all of them by default.
- [Deploying to GitHub Pages or Netlify](https://salahu01.github.io/quietfolio-template/blog/deploying-to-github-pages-or-netlify): quietfolio works on any host. There are two common setups.
